test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 25 May 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Launched in April 2021, the PM Umeed Scheme aims to provide skills training to around three lakh youths to become entrepreneurs. The tenure of this scheme is upto ___________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**2025-26.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__****PM Umeed Scheme**

__
 
• The Union govt launched **PM Udyam Mitra Excellence in Entrepreneurship Development (PMUmeed) Scheme.**
 
• Umeed stands for **Udyam Mitra Excellence in Entrepreneurship Development. **
 
• In this scheme, the Union govt. will create entrepreneurs and handhold young enterprises that are struggling.
 
• They **plan to provide training to more than 3 lakh youth to become entrepreneurs over the next 5 years.**
 
• This scheme would **facilitate loans to youths and connect them to appropriate markets.**
 
• These entrepreneurs could also become job providers.
 
• The **tenure of this scheme** is up to **2025-26.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**PM Mentoring Yuva Scheme

 
• The scheme for **Young Upcoming Versatile Authors abbreviates into YUVA.**
 
• It is a **PM Scheme for Mentoring Young Authors in the country.**
 
• It is a** great platform for young writers to be International leaders of tomorrow.**
 
• All these youth will be provided with an international platform to represent India and express themselves.
 
• The writers under the scheme will be **provided with a mentorship program in writing.**
 
• These candidates will be **offered a scholarship throughout the mentoring program.**
 
• The selected winners will be **provided with scholarship money of Rs. 50,000/- every month for six months.**
